working: A: Force qE is along the field, so motion is a straight line. B: With v ⟂ E, acceleration is along E, giving a uniformly accelerated motion – a parabola. C: If v ∥ B, v × B = 0, so no magnetic force; the particle moves in a straight line, not a helix. D: If v ⟂ B, the magnetic force is always perpendicular to v, producing uniform circular motion in a plane normal to B.
